headline: High risk tomorrow: start early and stop by 11 AM.

best_work_window.reason: Heat index stays under 100°F and storm chance under 20% until 11 AM.

items.text: Thunderstorms likely after 1 PM (70% chance). Any strike within 10 miles stops work for 30 minutes.
Heat index reaches 106°F by 1 PM. Plan water and shade breaks every hour.
Ground is still saturated from this week's rain. Expect mud; keep heavy vehicles on the gravel pad.
A crew member reported an alligator by the culvert near pole 14 today. Keep clear of standing water.
